parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The type of connection to retrieve. Valid values:
- **WorkBench**: Logs on to the container through the WorkBench page.
- **WebShell**: Logs on to the container through a WebSocket URL. This option does not support processor-type services or services created before June 2026.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the service instance.

parameters.name: WorkerName
parameters.description: The name of the service worker. You can call the ListServiceContainers operation to obtain the worker name.
